reading back is never yanked to the newest line — Reading back is never yanked down (US-08): live-transcript-list.test 'stops following while the user reads back...' — mutation (always scrollToEnd) turns it red

ending with pending segments shows sync progress and loses none — Ending with pending segments shows sync progress and loses none (US-16): sync-worker sends end only when pending==0 (sync-worker.test socket case), EndingPanel shows progress; chaos test 30 simulated kills → every seq exactly once

findings.summary: (Fixed.) An account switch during an in-flight sync pass could upload user A's queued meeting with user B's token. Fixed with an axios request-interceptor guard (expectedOwnerId checked where the token is attached) plus the worker stopping on owner change; regression tests: sync-worker.test mid-flight switch, axios-client-owner-guard.test.
(Fixed.) A failed disk write dropped the utterance; now kept in memory and retried in order, end refuses while text is unsaved; test added.
Notification tap after the OS killed the process lands on Home (unfinished-meeting banner), not screen 06. No data loss; documented limitation.
